work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: This raw frame opens with the right half of a running title (LF50365) and the last lines of allocution CCXXVI (LF50371–50377, reviewed with that allocution); its act is indult CCXXVII (numeral OCR CCXXVIT.), granting the Velletri archpriest and canons violet collar, cassock and sash and the archpriest the mantelletta; LF50437 → LF50446 across own provenance LF50440 and page number 344 LF50443; complete 12 July 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF50391–50391; the source closing at LF50471–50474 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima secunda iulii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
